title: Actions & Everything
description: A Fabric modpack that makes Minecraft feel fresh again while staying true to vanilla.
body:
**This Modpack is meant to be used with classic tools fusion of curseforge but due to content rules I cannot put it in the modpack**

# Actions & Everything


This modpack was created to enhance Minecraft's immersive and enjoyable aspects without drastically altering the game. It focuses on improving movement and player interactions, incorporating quality-of-life enhancements, visual upgrades, and performance optimizations through a carefully selected set of Fabric mods. The goal is to restore a fun, pressure-free gameplay experience, reminiscent of vanilla Minecraft while avoiding over-the-top features. The collection consists of mods and resource packs designed to make the game feel more alive and engaging.

![Campsite With a White Tent and Giant Nether Portal Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/482d6b8222abdbdd33cc7e2775d26825c0be891d.png)

  
### How to install Classic Tools Fusion
- Search for "Classic Tools Fusion"
- Click on the link that says "Classic Tools Fusion-CTF 1 (NOT Classic Tools Fusion Compats)
- Get corresponding version and place in resource pack folder
- Enable in Minecraft settings
